name: Sealed Systems
summary: Masterwork Trait: Sealed Systems; Eligible Item: Armour; Effect: Gain advantage on saves against gas, smoke and airborne toxins. If the armour is already sealed, it also tolerates brief vacuum exposure without a separate suit breach test.
